title: Jiwa Yang Lembut Di Kalangan Para Nabi .
intro: Saboh su nyang meuhôi keu keubeunaran meu-gema rot ayat-ayat Al-Quran nyang Mulia. Jiwa nyang meubarakah nyoe geubri nubuat dan kitab ilahi bak watee bimbingan nyang that-that peureulee lamkawan Bani Israel. Individu nyoe geupeugah haba langsong ngon umat awaknyan, geuyue awaknyan keu jiingat Tuhan awaknyan. Meulalui saba dan bakti, awaknyan jeuet keu saboh lampu cahaya nyang kisah jih jipeutrang halaman-halaman kitab suci. Jeuet gata taidentifikasi tokoh nyang luar biasa nyoe nyang nan jih teupeumulia lam Al-Quran dan Injil?
clues: Lon dihormati deungon kenabian dan kitab syuruga bak masa umat lon peureulee.
Mak ulôn peulahé ulôn deungon tjara njang luar biasa, deungon peurintah Ilahi Allah mantong.
Lon peugah ubak umat lon, 'Hai Bani Israel! Lon nakeuh utusan Allah keu gata, nyang peukong peue nyang ka teuka sigohlom lon.'
Lon teuka deungon tanda-tanda nyang jeulaih nibak Tuhan gata, ngon lon ba haba seunang keuhai sidroe nabi nyang nan jih Ahmad.
Mak lon nakeuh sidroe inong nyang saleh dan geujok lon keu Allah mulai masa muda.
Allah geupeurunoe lon Al-Quran dan geupeugot lon belas kasihan dan bertugas keu mak, dan lon hana sombong atawa hana ta’at.

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verse: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic." (61:6)
